name: PHP Guard demo CVE feed (fixture, made-up entries)
note: Used when CVE_FEED=fixture (the default in development). Same shapes as the NVD CVE API 2.0 ('nvd') and php.net release JSON ('php_releases'). Add an entry and the next Watchdog poll will alert matching sites. IDs here are fictional. 'kev' and 'epss' mimic CISA KEV entries and FIRST EPSS scores.

descriptions.value: Demo only: a made-up flaw in PHP 8.3 before 8.3.40 that lets a crafted upload crash PHP workers.
